A portable defibrillator. Use it on the chest of a patient whose heart has stopped, before the brain dies. Shocking a beating heart burns it.
A compact Syndicate submachine gun. Fast and light-hitting, it needs both hands. Use to reload.

A timed demolition charge. Place it and arm from the interaction menu, or use it on a wall or door to attach and arm. Its red display counts down fifteen seconds; an audible countdown runs throughout and speeds up at the end. Wirecutters take three seconds to defuse it; stay in reach.

A two-handed flame projector. Hold primary in Harm to spray a wide fan of burning fuel up to four metres. Fuel sticks to people and surfaces, burns for six seconds and blackens surfaces. Holds sixty fuel pulses. Use to refill in four seconds.
A cyan ion rifle. Burns its target; no EMP effect. Use to replenish its charge.
A focused laser rifle. Delivers burn damage. Use to replenish its charge.
The standard Security sidearm. One-handed, with a ten-round magazine. Use to reload.
A Syndicate pistol: small, one-handed and hard-hitting. Use to reload.
A Security baton with a charged head. A hit knocks the target down and tires them out; it goes through armor.

A huge, heavy Syndicate explosive: too big to lift, so it has to be dragged into place. Set its timer (90 seconds at least) and arm it, then bolt it to the floor with a wrench; once armed the bolts lock, so nobody can drag it off. It beeps loudly enough to hear from the next room. Defusing takes a screwdriver to open its wiring panel, then wirecutters.
A one-use Syndicate beacon. Use it in hand and a Syndicate bomb lands in front of you; the bomb is too heavy to carry, so only call it down where you mean to use it.
A compact syndicate grenade. Arm it in hand or use Throw minibomb to pull the pin and throw. Its five-second fuse ends in a small explosion. An armed minibomb cannot be defused.
A short-range electrical weapon. Knocks an unarmored target down and drains stamina; a hardsuit stops the knockdown. Holds three charges and recharges slowly. Use to replenish its charge.

A powerful directional demolition charge. Hold it and use it on a wall or door to attach and arm. Its fifteen-second audible countdown speeds up toward detonation. Extra blast force spreads in a cone through the far side of the target. Wirecutters take three seconds to defuse it.
